  ╭─  💻 in your other terminal  ──────────────────────────────────────── [●‿●] ──
  │
  │  Save the version
  │  Why: "the version, because features and defaults change between releases;"
  │
  │  Go to your practice copy and save that output for the check:
  │
  │   $ cd /home/sam/claude-code-practice
  │   $ mkdir -p .practice                              ✔ .practice/ exists
  │   $ claude --version > .practice/version.txt
  │
  │  Done when .practice/version.txt holds a line such as X.Y.Z (Claude Code).
  │
  │  👀 Part of this check takes a while, so it runs only when you ask: press r
  │  when you are ready.
